map: LOC 12th Army Group situation map, 27 Dec 1944

units.result: record [5.69, 49.905]  reader [5.69, 49.86]  5 km  ok  note: Armor oval marked 4 with XX, just south of the Bastogne corridor near Martelange.

readerNotes.line: Line read from the heavy ticked line. North end taken where it comes down along the Maas side at about 5.84E; the double hatched Westwall band near Aachen was not used. Bastogne shown as a salient joined to the south by the 4th Armored corridor. South east end leaves the east edge near Saarlautern; a second heavy line running south from there toward Metz looks like a boundary and was not followed.
